# Is this bug a *ship stopper* (Yes/No)? Who other than the bug owner has reviewed this for SS applicability?
No. [~anichola], [~sinm], [~tsair], [~rajt].
 # What is the *impact of the bug* to the customer(s)?
An EMS alert may be generated and one or more of the internal CX7 temperature sensors won't be available under particular circumstances.
 # Could this defect impact *Software Defined or* *Cloud customer(s)* (ONTAP Select, FSx, CVO, CVS | ANF, Quark | Atom)?  If yes, please specify environments affected and if the bug would prevent deployment of a release with the bug.
No, the only functionality affected is the temperature reading and reporting of the internal CX7 temperature sensors.
 # What is required for a *customer to hit* this bug? How would a customer run into this defect? What is the *probability of hitting* the issue on a production system?
It happens at random after an Emerald crash. The issue has only been observed through a testing command, and never during regular system usage. The probability of hitting the issue in the field is very small, it requires another issue happening first (to trigger the Emerald crash).
 # Is there a *customer acceptable workaround* that can be used to avoid this bug?
Restarting the NSM module will fix the issue.
 # What is *the technical risk* when making a fix to this bug? Include any risk or changes to Manufacturing Ops scripts or EPIC/IMT configurations if any. If the defect is suspected to have an impact on the manufacturing ops test scripts, please contact +_[ng-ops-engineering-cto@netapp.com|mailto:ng-ops-engineering-cto@netapp.com]_+ and add +[{_}ng-ops-engineering-cto@netapp.com{_}|mailto:ng-ops-enginnering-cto@netapp.com]+ email group to the JIRA. Refer to this page for detailed information on Manufacturing items: +[Assessing Defects for Impact to Manufacturing|https://confluence.ngage.netapp.com/display/ORP/Assessing+Defects+for+Impact+to+Manufacturing].+
Technical risk of the fix is low, an error path needs to be handled differently. [~candyx] confirmed this issue won't affect manufacturing scripts, as TongaPlus testing won't have CX7 cards installed.
 # What is the *Test Impact* of adding this change? Which *code areas and dependent teams* (including CSAR or STE) may be impacted? Which *regression tests* should be executed if any?
Only the failed test needs to be repeated.  Would need to be tested by shelf FW team.
 # When was this {*}bug introduced{*}? What change number, release, and/or general time frame? Add a link to the issue introduced in *issue links* defect through "is_caused_by" relation.
TongaPlus day 1 issue.
 # Does this fix need to be ported to any other ONTAP P patches or Major Releases? If yes, please specify the codelines/versions.
No.

h1. Root Cause Analysis

The error happens during the CX7 internal temperature reading routine. The pointer to the driver context in the card data is NULL, which leads to a {{STATUS_INVALID_PARAMETER}} error:
{code}
Thread 45 "enclmgmtd" hit Breakpoint 2, HAL_PlatSWProduct_Get_Network_Card_Temperature (halContext=0x5557807aed30, index=0 '\000', pTemperature=0x7fc13affa078) at ../platswproduct.c:2074
2074    ../platswproduct.c: No such file or directory.
halContext = 0x5557807aed30
index = 0 '\000'
pTemperature = 0x7fc13affa078
prodContext = 0x5557807f43e0
pCardData = 0x5557807f4830
$1 = {fruIdx = 0 '\000', type = HAL_NETWORK_CARD_TYPE_MT2910, name = "CX7", '\000' <repeats 11 times>, driverContext = 0x0}
{code}

The driver context pointer is NULL due to an error during initialization in the Mellanox {{InitCapabilities}} routine, which doesn't stop Emerald from succesfully completing the startup:
{code}
Thu Jun 26 14:56:59 2025 (    0+00:06:52.460); 02000358; U?; HAL; hal; 04; Mellanox: error while parsing register PCAM (status=7)
Thu Jun 26 14:56:59 2025 (    0+00:06:52.460); 0200036C; U?; HAL; hal; 02; PlatSWProduct: driver initialization failed for network card 0 (7)
{code}

h1.  Impact

[~tsair] confirmed ONTAP will emit a single alert in the EMS every time a sensor goes to the Unkown state. [~sinm] found that EMS alert in the events of the system:
{code}

6/26/2025 14:58:55  stqa-rtp-vinom-6a ALERT        ses.status.temperatureWarning: NX224NSM140 (S/N 952445000975) shelf 15 on channel 0x temperature warning for Temperature sensor 30: not installed or failed. Current temperature: 0 C (32 F). This element is on the unknown location.
{code}

h1. Reproducibility

I was able to reproduce the issue while running the command "watchdog_tp 1" on loop on our OAMTongaPlus-1b system. Found the issue in 15 out of 348 iterations (once every ~23). When running power cycle loops for 70 iterations, the issue could not be reproduced.
